thread:
harry: heads-up 0min ago console showed transient duplicate streams for the same client_id across a handful of eu shards. snippet: ```WARN sse.runtime: resume_token=present allocated_new_session=true prev_lease=lease-77 new_sid=sess-c12 route=eu3 reason=lease_mismatch```
mina: was billing impacted?
harry: invoices look fine. only per-route active_streams jumped and alert fired.
dev: my hunch is sticky-lease decay + resume idempotency header mismatch. if a client reconnects during lease decay we sometimes lose the mapping and allocate a new session even though a resume token was presented. telemetry doesn't mark that as "attempted resume" so console treats it as a separate connection.
mina: can we add a resume_outcome tag (accepted|fallback|collision) on the low-cardinality sse.session_start counter? keep tenant out of the tagset to avoid explosion.
dev: yes. also propose a tiny sampled event when token present + new session allocated, include prev_lease_shard and new_shard and a short reason code. sample 0.5% and hash the client_ip.
harry: for the UI, product asked for something that reduces noise. idea: show a compact "lineage" indicator (small chevron) that groups sessions that reattached within a short window. Grouping heuristic: same client_id + resume_token_present within 7s OR dedup_key = tenant + client_id + 7s_window. Tooltip: "Grouped: client reattached; routing fallback allocated a new backend session. Not double billed."
mina: 7s seems aggressive; some networks are flaky. I prefer 15s. but shorter window reduces NAT false grouping. put behind FF.
dev: alternative: label as "likely resume" if token present AND prev_last_seen < 10s AND token header x-resume-id matches. we already emit x-resume-id but it has collisions for long-lived tokens; might need namespace prefixing per-lease.
ops-bot: alert suppressed: sse.dup_conn_spike resolved at 2026-04-03T08:12:40Z
pm: product: prefer copy "This group indicates the client reattached; no additional charges." will review final wording.
harry: rollout plan: 1) telemetry tag + sampled diag (canary 5% tenants), 2) alert tweak to ignore dup spikes when resume_ratio>0.4, 3) console FF with lineage grouping for internal, 4) monitor FP rate (false grouping) and adjust window.
dev: PRs: telem: sse/session_outcome, diag emitter; runtime: try to prefer reattach on same shard when lease age < 2s; console: grouping UI behind FF.
mina: add runbook note: if duplicates persist and resume_ratio low, check sticky-lease decay config and recent route rebalances.
console-bot: ticket PLAT-10011 created "SSE resume lineage grouping + telemetry" assigned to harry, mina, dev
harry: assigning canary for telemetry tomorrow 09:00 UTC. will post status in #release-war-room. :thumbsup:
